# CANDIDATE: VIX_RSI_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Divergence between intraday VIX and SPY RSI signals an impending reversal; trading opposite the VIX move after a confirmed divergence yields an edge. Bearish divergence (VIX makes higher high while SPY RSI makes lower high) predicts short opportunities; bullish divergence (VIX makes lower low while SPY RSI makes higher low) predicts long opportunities.

## Mechanism

Compute 5-minute RSI(14) on SPY and 5-minute VIX. For bearish divergence: VIX prints a new high (higher than the prior three highs) while SPY RSI fails to exceed its prior high (lower high). For bullish divergence: VIX prints a new low (lower than the prior three lows) while SPY RSI prints a higher low. Require volume > average volume on the signal bar. Enter short at close of the VIX high bar on bearish divergence; enter long at close of the VIX low bar on bullish divergence. Exit shape: Stop beyond the recent swing point (high for short, low for long) plus 0.25%; target 1R; then trail with a chandelier exit (ATR(2)×2). Regime hint: Effective when VIX is between 12‑22 (moderate) and the time is 10:00–14:30 EST; avoid extreme VIX <10 or >30 where divergence signals are less reliable.
